source.name: flybody
source.attribution: FlyBody: anatomically-detailed MuJoCo model of the adult fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster, from the Turaga Lab (HHMI Janelia Research Campus) with Google DeepMind.

used_for: kinematic tree: body positions and orientations for the rest pose
geom placement: per-mesh local offsets and rotations
material table: flat RGBA colours per anatomical material

geometry.note: Only visual geoms are converted. MuJoCo collision primitives (classes 'collision', 'collision-membrane', 'adhesion-collision') are skipped; they are physics volumes, not anatomy.

modifications: Kinematic tree baked to world space at the model's default (rest) pose.
Meshes grouped by material and concatenated, then decimated with quadric edge collapse.
Coordinate system converted from MuJoCo Z-up to glTF Y-up.
Model recentred and uniformly scaled so body length is 1.0 scene unit.
Wings split into their own nodes, with geometry expressed relative to each wing hinge so they can be animated in the browser.
Flat MuJoCo materials mapped to glTF PBR metallic-roughness materials.
not_used: MuJoCo physics (joints, actuators, tendons, adhesion, fluid model)
flybody Python runtime, tasks, agents and training code
the .msh binary meshes (the .obj sources are used instead)
